explanation: Bugeaud's Section 4.4 is paywalled and was not read. Checked independently: IsRichInBase says every finite digit block occurs, which is Wikipedia's definition of a disjunctive/rich number. Density of (bⁿξ) in the circle implies an orbit point in the interior of each b-adic block interval, and conversely any block's occurrence places an orbit point in a small interval. Terminating expansions are neither rich nor dense, so the digit convention causes no problem. Correct.
